items.name: FYR Business Consulting
items.summary: Distinctive consulting brand with a blocked first impression, placeholder footer/contact details, and service-path clarity issues. Recommend first outreach because the fix is obvious and highly screenshot-friendly.
items.recommendation: First outreach target: popup/template-leftover cleanup plus consultation CTA clarity.

items.name: Dedicated Mobile Detailing
items.summary: Strong black/yellow auto-detailing page with good assets; conversion can improve by simplifying hero actions, setting quote expectations, and grouping services by buyer intent.
items.recommendation: First outreach target: good bones plus clear conversion cleanup opportunity.

items.name: Anytime Mobile Detailing LLC
items.summary: Dark automotive Webador site with useful assets but visible polish issues: early deposit policy, service typo, raw rating widget, repeated hero slides, and placeholder-style testimonial.
items.recommendation: Good follow-up outreach after the first two; clear copy and hierarchy cleanup.
